summary: Cel-Sci Corp filed an 8-K reporting a share placement via a placement agency agreement with ThinkEquity LLC. It issued 6 million common shares at $1.20 per share, grossing $7.2 million. Net proceeds fund Multikine development, general corporate purposes, and working capital. The offering closed on May 13, 2026, under an effective S-1. The placement agent receives a 7% cash fee and up to $150k expense reimbursement. There is a 30-day company lock-up and 45-day insider lock-up on further issuances or sales. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Watch for insider selling once lock-up expires.
